If a workspace plan has one Greenhouse Member and another builtin full-pipeline Member, taskUsesGreenhouseGate returns true because the plan-level provider is Greenhouse, so isFullPipelineTask returns false even for the builtin Member. Existing candidate, validation, CI-fix, merge, and review-fix paths that call isFullPipelineTask(member) therefore skip the builtin Member's required private-candidate pipeline and can treat it as a non-full-pipeline lane.","action":"Make the full-pipeline classification provider-aware for the supplied repository, using the frozen Member provider (and the configured fallback only where appropriate), so a Greenhouse Member is excluded without disabling builtin full-pipeline Members in the same workspace.","rule":"","head":"e86dccac507a58ba54f1dc40c8559ab6f03736bf"}]}

If a workspace plan has one Greenhouse Member and another builtin full-pipeline Member, taskUsesGreenhouseGate returns true because the plan-level provider is Greenhouse, so isFullPipelineTask returns false even for the builtin Member. Existing candidate, validation, CI-fix, merge, and review-fix paths that call isFullPipelineTask(member) therefore skip the builtin Member's required private-candidate pipeline and can treat it as a non-full-pipeline lane.","action":"Make the full-pipeline classification provider-aware for the supplied repository, using the frozen Member provider (and the configured fallback only where appropriate), so a Greenhouse Member is excluded without disabling builtin full-pipeline Members in the same workspace.","rule":"","head":"e86dccac507a58ba54f1dc40c8559ab6f03736bf"}]}
